text: Fear of rejection kills more men's chances than rejection itself. Guys, let's be real. Too many men sit around paralyzed by the thought. What if she says no? You like a girl. You want to ask her out. A doubt eats you alive. Here's the truth. Rejection is not the enemy. Doing nothing is. So what's the worst case scenario? You ask her out. She says no. And yeah, I get it. If that's your classmate, your co-worker, or a girl you'll still see regularly, it might feel awkward. But that's the risk you have to be willing to take. No risk, no reward. And let's be honest, is that really so terrible? You can play it off, stay cool, even tell her, that's fine, I don't want this to create any awkwardness between us. And even if it does, worst case, you lose contact with a girl who wasn't interested in you in the first place. That just means more motivation to move on and try things with other women. And here's the key. The fact that you had the courage to ask out a girl you liked does not mean you're less of a man. In fact, it makes you more of a man. You did what you wanted to do. You showed fearlessness, decisiveness, and that you're not afraid to take risk. That alone makes you stand out from 90% of other guys. The men who win in dating aren't the ones who always play it safe. They are the ones who lean into the risk, who take chances, who say, screw it, and go for it. So don't be the coward who never tries. Take the shot. Because the more you risk, the better your life gets.
